archetypes.name: test-mode-hook-design
archetypes.rationale: New LARCH_CHECK_REVIEWERS_TEST_MODE hooks are added to production code; their gating consistency and the codex-env-key special-case removal deserve architectural scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate the new test-mode hook infrastructure in scripts/check-reviewers.sh (LARCH_CHECK_REVIEWERS_TEST_MODE, LARCH_CHECK_REVIEWERS_TEST_SETUP_LOG, LARCH_CHECK_REVIEWERS_TEST_FAIL_SETUP_STEP): compare the gating pattern to the existing LARCH_LIB_CURSOR_AUTH_TEST_MODE=1 double-sentinel design in lib-cursor-auth.sh and assess whether the protection level is equivalent. Determine whether setting AUTH_ATTEMPT=MAX_AUTH_RETRIES as a named variable before a one-shot probe is the right abstraction, or whether the one-shot code path should be self-contained without borrowing a loop variable whose semantics belong to the full retry loop. Assess the behavioral change from removing the codex-env-key false-stamp bypass (the old AND condition in check-reviewers.sh around line 329) — specifically whether the shared LARCH_PROBE_NEGATIVE_TTL_SECONDS=0 default produces identical visible behavior for operators who had previously relied on env-key mode always re-probing on false. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
